patch.value: Round-trip Linear estimate and cycle on export

On 'pm linear export', an item carrying the importer's estimate:<n> tag sets the Linear issue input.estimate (integer), and the cycle:<name> tag resolves to a cycleId and sets input.cycleId; both work for issueCreate and issueUpdate. estimate:/cycle: tags are NOT re-emitted as Linear labels. Unresolvable cycle names are skipped (no crash) with a single stderr warning per push. --map estimate=ignore and --map cycle=ignore opt out. Dry-run/preview output reflects estimate + cycle. Offline-safe; no live API required by tests.

value.author: codex
value.text:
DESIGN + TRACE (export estimate/cycle round-trip)

WHAT I TRACED:
- Import side (index.ts buildItemPlan ~895): Linear estimate -> 'estimate:<n>' tag; Linear cycle.name -> 'cycle:<name>' tag. pm has no first-class estimate/cycle field, hence the namespaced-tag encoding.
- Export side: itemToLinearPayload (now ~1140) builds LinearCreatePayload from item.tags; applyExportFields (offline plan, ~1280) + the real push input builders (~1900 create/update) previously applied ONLY priority/labels/dueDate. estimate + cycle were dropped -> silent round-trip data loss. Linear IssueCreateInput/IssueUpdateInput support 'estimate' (number) and 'cycleId' (string).

WHY CYCLE NEEDS ID RESOLUTION:
The tag carries a cycle NAME, but Linear's mutation input wants 'cycleId'. Labels already use the same pattern (resolveLabelIds via the team-context map). I extended resolveTeamContext's TEAM_QUERY to also fetch cycles { id name number } and build cyclesByName (keyed by lower-cased name AND number, since numbered cycles often have no name). resolveCycleId() maps the tag name -> id. Unresolved (offline/dry-run/unknown/workspace-without-cycles) is skipped gracefully with a single stderr warning per push (warnedUnresolvedCycle flag, reset at the top of each --push via resetCycleWarning()), mirroring the 'drop unknown labels' policy so a push never crashes on a cycle the team doesn't model.

IMPLEMENTATION:
- New pure exported helpers: parseEstimateTag, parseCycleTag, isReservedExportTag, resolveCycleId, applyPushDynamicFields (+resetCycleWarning).
- itemToLinearPayload(item, fieldMap) parses estimate:/cycle: tags onto payload.estimate / payload.cycleName and EXCLUDES those tags from payload.labels (de-dup; they would be rejected as unknown Linear labels and double-encode otherwise). Honors --map estimate=ignore / cycle=ignore (added 'cycle' to KNOWN_LINEAR_FIELDS; registered --map flag on 'linear export').
- applyExportFields (offline plan) emits input.estimate + input.cycleName + a '<cycle-id-for:NAME>' cycleId placeholder, symmetric with the existing labelIds placeholder, so --dry-run JSON matches the push.
- Real push: applyPushDynamicFields sets input.estimate (finite) and resolves input.cycleId via teamCtx.cyclesByName; shared by both issueCreate + issueUpdate paths.
- No-push preview now shows estimate + cycle.

ARCHITECTURE: import type only (no SDK runtime import); only the existing Linear GraphQL client used (one extra field on the already-issued TEAM_QUERY, no new round-trip); tests are fully offline via mocked cyclesByName + injectable warn fn — no token/live API.

TEST RESULTS: npm test => 44 pass / 0 fail (was 36; +8 new). New tests: parseEstimateTag, parseCycleTag, isReservedExportTag, itemToLinearPayload estimate/cycle promotion+label-exclusion, buildExportMutationPlan estimate+cycleId (create+update), applyPushDynamicFields resolve + unresolved-skip-warn-once, --map estimate/cycle=ignore, resolveCycleId. typecheck clean.
